profile.entities: Saatvik Green Energy Ltd (standalone + consol); Odisha greenfield integrated project (4 GW module + 4.8 GW cell); Ambala facility (3.8 GW module + 2 GW EPE film)
profile.mgmt: Neelesh Garg (Chairman & MD); Prashant Mathur (CEO); Abani Jha (CFO); Adfactors IR
profile.subseg: Solar modules (mono PERC / high-efficiency); EPE encapsulant film; solar cells (under build); EPC; solar pumps; inverters; storage (nascent)
profile.themes: Renewable-Integration (solar module supply into utility-scale/C&I solar capacity addition); Storage (nascent, not yet material)

bull_bear.body: - Net debt INR 749 cr (incl. term + working capital) at end-9MFY26. Leverage temporarily up from inventory pre-securing; mgmt stresses "capital discipline" and "disciplined growth over aggressive volume." No dividend/buyback discussion.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- Commodity volatility (silver ~9% daily swings) compressing spot-order margins.
- Industry overcapacity: ~140 GW ALMM module capacity, cell capacity 26 GW (12 GW obsolete Mono PERC) heading to 50-60 GW — mgmt downplays (industry util only 40-50%).
- Execution risk on Odisha cell ramp/efficiency stabilization. Rising interest cost. US tariff/policy uncertainty (final terms unsigned). Demand timing tied to ALMM cell mandate (tenders from ~June 2026, 18-24 month lag to installation).
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: - Confident, execution-focused; candid on margin dip drivers and partial pass-through; refused to disclose absolute realizations/market prices (typical). Emphasized 10-yr track record and disciplined growth. Some defensiveness/circularity in the flat-volume QoQ exchange. Credible on funding (fully tied up).
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The real margin re-rating is cell/DCR-led from H2FY27, not module volume — module pricing is a commodity pass-through game.
- Interest-cost spike is a deliberate strategic inventory bet on rising cell/silver prices, not distress — watch if it actually normalizes by March.
- Q4→Q1FY27 volume explicitly flagged flattish; new 4 GW module won't be fully available in FY27 (ramp). Mono PERC obsolescence is a tailwind for new cell capacity vs incumbents.
- Solar pump BU and inverter assembly are early call-options, immaterial today.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
- ~95% of consol revenue from modules (modules also embedded in EPC & pump sales). Solar pumps just ~0.35% — to be carved into a standalone BU this year.
- Module:non-module mix ~95:5 now; target ~85:15 over next couple of years as EPC/pump/inverter/cell scale.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary stock(s) | Loser | Why / conviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| ALMM cell mandate (cell+module made-in-India) from ~June 2026 | SAATVIKGL · 544526 (integrated cell + DCR coming) | Pure module assemblers reliant on imported cells | DCR/integration margin unlock; mandatory domestic cell demand. High |
| Silver/copper/aluminium inflation + INR depreciation | Vertically-integrated, long-contract players incl. SAATVIKGL · 544526 | Spot/short-term-order-heavy module sellers | Pass-through only on long-term contracts; spot margins compress. Med-High |
| Module capacity glut (~140 GW ALMM) | High-utilization low-cost integrated makers (SAATVIKGL · 544526 at 81%+) | Sub-scale high-cost module assemblers | Industry util 40-50%; weak players squeezed. Med |
| US tariff cut to 18% (from 50%) on Indian solar | Indian cell+module exporters incl. SAATVIKGL · 544526 (post-cell) | — | Reopens US demand once cells online; conviction Low (policy unsigned, <1% sales today) |
| Mono PERC cell obsolescence as new capacity uses high-efficiency tech | New high-efficiency cell builders incl. SAATVIKGL · 544526 | Legacy ~12 GW Mono PERC cell capacity | Old tech becomes uncompetitive as TOPCon/HJT scales. Med |
| Govt budget exemption on glass raw material | Domestic solar glass makers (e.g. Borosil Renewables (code unverified)); module makers via lower input cost incl. SAATVIKGL · 544526 | Glass importers | Cheaper domestic glass lowers module BOM over 1-2 yrs. Low-Med |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Frames its strategy as "Integrating the Value Chain. Scaling the Opportunity" — moving from solar manufacturer to an end-to-end integrated energy platform spanning ingots & wafers, cell, encapsulant and module.
- Positions vertical integration as a structural cost & margin moat as the industry shifts from module-led to cell-led competitiveness under India's ALMM regime (List-I modules enforced Apr 2021, List-II cells effective Jun 2026, List-III wafers/ingots expected Jun 2028); calls itself an early mover with committed capex.
- Claims to be among the fastest-growing Indian module makers, citing FY26 revenue of Rs.45,484 Mn (+111% YoY) and a confirmed 6.35 GW order book (~132% of installed capacity).
- One Portfolio, Multiple Solar Applications: extends reach across utility-scale, C&I distributed, agriculture and residential/small C&I segments, enabled by modules, inverters, transformers and (planned) BESS.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Corporate action] Company was renamed from Saatvik Green Energy Private Limited to Saatvik Green Energy Limited; now listed with BSE Scrip Code 544526 and NSE Symbol SAATVIKGL.
- [Award] Won 'Brand of the Year' at the India Power & Renewable Leadership Awards 2026.
- [Industry] Deck cites India's solar backdrop: 500 GW non-fossil capacity target by 2030 (283 GW installed as of Mar 2026, 217 GW gap); only 15.4% of India's 750 GW solar potential harnessed; India RE market seen growing from USD 24 Bn (2024) to USD 37 Bn (2030) at ~9% CAGR; annual solar demand seen rising from 50 GW (FY27E) to 85 GW (FY30E).
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body:
- Margin lever = backward integration: cells + DCR + in-house encapsulant. Silver is the swing input (now ~25% of module cost).
- Pass-through is partial: protected on long-term orders, exposed on short-term/spot. Govt budget exemption on glass raw material could ease module input costs over 1-2 yrs (Saatvik not in glass mfg itself).
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- New this quarter: 2 GW EPE encapsulant film facility (Ambala) commissioned & operational — fresh vertical-integration node.
- Margin: Q3 EBITDA 13.11% — a sequential dip from the ~16% 9M run-rate, attributed to commodity inflation + INR; mgmt guides Q4 recovery.
- Balance sheet: short-term borrowing taken to pre-secure cell inventory → interest cost spike; net debt INR 749 cr.
- Odisha timeline crystallized: module commercial Q1FY27, cell commercial ~Oct 2026 (H2FY27); capacity 4.8 → 8.8 GW module in FY27.
- Solar pump being formalized into a standalone BU (still ~0.35% of revenue). Inverter assembly setup announced. US tariff cut to 18% noted as positive but unconfirmed.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- Q4FY26: busiest quarter seasonally; commodity-pass-through lag should turn margin positive; "decent growth" QoQ and YoY. Volume Q4→Q1FY27 likely flattish (no new capacity online until Q1FY27 ramp).
- Margin: 13% EBITDA is the "realistic" full-year guide; 9M printed ~16%.
- FY27: aims to "defend" >100% growth trajectory (cited 88% revenue CAGR / 250% PAT growth historically) — directional, not committed.
- Verify next quarter: (a) Q4 margin recovery to ~15-16%; (b) interest cost normalization by March; (c) Odisha 4 GW module commercial production start mid-Q1FY27.
outlook.title: Guidance (forward)

outlook.body:
- Order book ~5.05 GW ≈ INR 6,500 cr; executed ~1 GW in Q3 and replenished with new orders.
- Mix: large utility-scale + C&I + EPC + distributed/retail; excludes spot/retail in stated book.
- Long-term contracts (6-12 month cycle) carry pass-through protection (customer secures cell or provides financial instrument; FX clause; change-in-law clause). Short-term (1-5 month) orders are fixed-price.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- Cells (Odisha 4.8 GW): biggest optionality — DCR policy gives extra margin to integrated cell makers; commercial production ~Oct 2026.
- EPE encapsulant film: 2 GW commissioned at Ambala this quarter (vertical integration, margin/quality control).
- Inverters: assembly manufacturing being set up. Solar pumps: standalone BU. Storage: flagged in closing remarks (nascent).
- Ingot/wafer: working on it, plans "ready"; will firm up after draft policy clarity (policy targeted ~June 2028). US export: <1% now, will re-pursue post tariff cut to 18% from 50% (over-and-above Section 201 ~14% — still being evaluated).
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Fast-scaling (≈140% YoY) ALMM solar module maker executing a backward-integration play into cells (DCR margin unlock) and encapsulant; Q3 margin dip is commodity/FX noise, structural story is the Odisha cell+module ramp from H2FY27.
